title: myosotis sylvatica var. alpina
intro: Myosotis sylvatica var. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Forget-Me-Not, is a variant of the Myosotis sylvatica plant, a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of insomnia, fever, and inflammation, suggesting its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Myosotis sylvatica var. alpina are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which may help soothe digestive issues and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
